name: Onboard and launch brand listings on Instacart, DoorDash and Gopuff
what: Take a brand through rapid-delivery/grocery marketplace onboarding end to end (Instacart, DoorDash Marketplace, Gopuff, Amazon Fresh): assemble the business licence, resale certificate, UPC/barcode and packaging documents, submit through each platform's own channel, and get the first live listing without a mismatched document resetting the queue. India: the same job runs on Blinkit, Zepto and Instamart instead, needing GST registration and an FSSAI licence (markets: IN, reads null for US brands).
encompasses: Assemble business licence, resale certificate, PAN/EIN, bank and UPC/GS1 barcode documents and check the legal-entity name matches exactly across every document (India: GST registration, FSSAI licence, PAN, bank and GS1 barcode documents instead; markets: IN, reads null for US brands)

Submit through Instacart's Retailer/CPG portal, DoorDash Marketplace's vendor channel and Gopuff's supplier channel, each with its own workflow (India: Blinkit's Seller App, Zepto's category-manager channel and Instamart's seller portal; markets: IN)

For a food SKU, check the FDA facility registration and any state food licence has enough validity left before submitting, since a near-expiry licence gets rejected (India: check the FSSAI licence has 6 to 12 months validity left)
Build catalogue assets to each platform's exact size and crop rule (1000x1000px, front/back/lifestyle)
Write titles in the platform's required order: brand, product, variant, pack size
Verify barcodes scan in a shelf-stacked position and labels stay legible at thumbnail size
Track submission status and chase the missing document holding up approval
Flag when a legal-entity name mismatch or missing document will reset the queue
inputs: brand brain: business documents, licensing status (india: GST and FSSAI licence status)
product tech pack and packaging specs

external_write.surface: Instacart / DoorDash / Gopuff seller portal (india: Blinkit seller app / Zepto category manager / Instamart seller portal)

founder_sees: The onboarding checklist, the document blocking approval, and the platform's own timeline.

name: Correct rapid-delivery ROAS and validate dark-store unit economics
what: Recompute true return on ad spend from transaction value, not list price, because some rapid-delivery and quick-commerce platform dashboards inflate ROAS 30 to 50 percent by reporting off list/MRP price, and hold a SKU to a run of positive contribution margin before it scales past the first dark stores.
encompasses: Pull platform ad spend and list-price-based ROAS from the seller dashboard
Recompute ROAS on actual transaction value in code, net of platform commission (15-25%) and sales tax (india: GST) on commission
Track inwarding fees, storage cost and damage/expiry write-off (budgeted 2-5% of list price) per SKU
Calculate weekly per-dark-store order volume needed to clear the 55-60% gross margin floor
Flag whether a margin problem is volume (fixable with more orders) or structural (needs repricing or a COGS cut)
Hold expansion to new SKUs or metro areas until 3 consecutive weeks of positive contribution margin
founder_sees: The true ROAS next to the platform's reported ROAS, and the scale/hold/kill call with the number behind it.
today_done_by: founder (dashboard usually taken at face value)

name: Manage rapid-delivery ad credits and promotional calendar negotiation
what: Spend each platform's ad tools deliberately instead of leaving credits unused or overspending once organic search picks up, and negotiate the peak promotional windows (Q4 holiday season, Black Friday/Cyber Monday, Prime Day, back to school) that can lift sales 4 to 5x.
encompasses: Activate and track per-SKU ad credits on Instacart Ads at launch
Run keyword-bid sponsored search on DoorDash Ads and Gopuff's self-serve ads portal
Monitor organic impressions and click-through rate weekly and cut paid spend on a SKU once organic CTR clears the category average
Draft the ask to the category manager for BFCM, Prime Day, back-to-school and Q4 holiday promotional slots (India: Diwali, Holi, IPL and Independence Day slots; markets: IN)
Track a 5-15% of projected revenue ad budget and reallocate as organic velocity rises
Seed early reviews with an introductory discount tied to sponsored search
inputs: US retail promotional calendar (india: festive calendar)
trigger: weekly, and ahead of each peak promotional window
founder_sees: The ad spend plan by SKU and platform, and the promotional-window ask before it goes to the category manager.

name: Monitor dark-store fill rate and replenishment cadence
what: Watch stock levels across the dark-store network the way a merchandiser watches shelf stock, because a stockout there triggers an algorithmic ranking penalty that takes time to recover from.
encompasses: Pull per-dark-store, per-SKU stock level and days-of-cover from the platform's inventory feed where available
Flag a SKU approaching stockout at any dark store before the ranking penalty hits
Track inbound replenishment frequency against the platform's required cadence
Track inwarding fee (about $0.25-0.50/unit on rapid-delivery platforms; india: about Rs 2-4/unit on Instamart, markets: IN) and damage/expiry write-offs against budget
Recommend a replenishment order in units per dark store from recent velocity
inputs: quick commerce seller dashboard stock export
founder_sees: Which dark stores are about to stock out, and the replenishment order to send.

name: Select and onboard a domestic fulfilment 3PL and WMS
what: Run the RFP, SLA negotiation and integration test for a domestic order-fulfilment 3PL and its warehouse management system, separate from the import-side freight and factory 3PL already covered.
encompasses: Draft the RFP: order volume, SKU count, pick profile, peak multiplier, required integrations (Shopify, marketplaces)
Score 3PL bids on pick accuracy history, dock-to-stock time and integration depth, not lowest quote alone
Negotiate SLA terms: same-day cutoff, error-rate cap, chargeback terms for mis-picks
Run an integration test: an order flows in, stock syncs back, a test shipment completes end to end
Check WMS support for real-time multi-channel stock sync to prevent overselling
Write the go-live checklist and a rollback plan if the 3PL underperforms in week one
founder_sees: The scored 3PL comparison and the SLA terms before signing.
human_role: warehouse and fulfilment lead / operations manager

name: Configure warehouse slotting, pick-pack workflow and labor scheduling
what: Set the operational rules a fulfilment manager owns day to day once the 3PL or in-house warehouse is live: slotting by velocity, a pick-pack-QC method, and staffing against demand forecast and seasonal peaks.
encompasses: Slot SKUs by sales velocity to shorten pick travel paths
Design the pick, pack and QC method to cut mis-pick and mis-ship rate
Build the staffing schedule from the demand forecast, including seasonal peak multipliers
Schedule cycle counts on high-value SKUs and reconcile discrepancies
Track dock-to-stock time, pick accuracy, lines per hour and cost per order
Flag when a KPI breaches its threshold for two consecutive weeks
founder_sees: The KPI dashboard and any threshold breach with the fix.

name: Build the returns and reverse-logistics grading workflow
what: Design what happens to a unit that comes back, whether a carrier return-to-sender (india: RTO) or a customer return, so it is graded, restocked, refurbished or written off on a fixed rule instead of case by case.
encompasses: Define grading rules at intake: resell as new, resell as open-box, refurbish, scrap
Tie the refund or store-credit trigger to the warehouse scan, not the courier's return-in-transit status
Route a defective return into the QC/CAPA process to trace it to a batch
Track return processing time and reverse-logistics cost per unit

Separate a failed delivery / carrier return-to-sender (never delivered) from a customer return (delivered then returned) in reporting (India: this never-delivered leg is RTO; markets: IN, reads null for US brands)
Flag a SKU or reason code whose return rate has moved outside its normal range
founder_sees: The return rate by SKU and reason, and any batch flagged for a defect pattern.

name: Run daily multi-courier rate-shop and failover routing
what: Pick the carrier for each shipment in code from live rate, ZIP code serviceability and SLA rather than a fixed default carrier, and fail over to a backup carrier the moment one rejects or is unserviceable (India: same logic on pincode serviceability and courier RTO rate; markets: IN).
encompasses: Pull live rate cards and ZIP code serviceability for every connected carrier (UPS, USPS, FedEx, and 3PLs such as ShipBob or ShipMonk)
Score each carrier on cost, promised transit time and recent failed-delivery/return-to-sender rate for that ZIP code (India: courier RTO rate for that pincode; markets: IN)
Assign the shipment to the best-scoring carrier automatically through the shipping platform (ShipStation, EasyPost)
Fail over to the next-best carrier on rejection, non-serviceability or capacity cap
Log every routing decision so a carrier's real performance can be audited later

external_write.surface: ShipStation / EasyPost API (india: Shiprocket / aggregator API)

founder_sees: The routing rule and a weekly summary of what it saved versus a single default carrier.

name: Automate carrier-exception resolution and address-validation outreach
what: Work every carrier exception the day it is raised: run USPS/carrier address validation and reach out to the customer to confirm the address or reschedule before the delivery window closes, since exception handling cuts return-to-sender more than the carrier rate does. India: the same job is NDR (non-delivery report) resolution on cash-on-delivery orders (markets: IN, reads null for US brands).
encompasses: Pull the day's carrier-exception queue (undeliverable-as-addressed, failed attempt, hold-for-pickup) across UPS, USPS, FedEx and connected 3PLs (India: the aggregator's NDR queue across all couriers; markets: IN)
Run address validation and send a confirmation or reschedule message by SMS (with TCPA consent and quiet hours) or email before the next attempt (India: SMS or WhatsApp; markets: IN)
Escalate a repeat-exception order to a phone call before it converts to return-to-sender (India: before it converts to RTO; markets: IN)
Reassign a chronically bad ZIP code's future orders to a carrier with a better first-attempt rate there (India: a chronically bad pincode; markets: IN)
Track exception-to-delivery conversion rate versus exception-to-return-to-sender rate by reason code (India: NDR-to-delivery versus NDR-to-RTO rate; markets: IN)
inputs: customer contact channel (SMS, email; india: SMS or WhatsApp)

external_write.surface: SMS/email send, carrier exception panel (india: SMS/WhatsApp send, aggregator NDR panel)

founder_sees: The exception-to-return-to-sender conversion rate and what outreach recovered.
today_done_by: tool (aggregator's built-in exception panel, human-run; india: NDR panel)

name: Reconcile courier billing disputes and payment-remittance discrepancies
what: Match every carrier's weight/dimension bill against the order record and file a dispute on any discrepancy, because unreconciled carrier billing quietly eats margin. India: the same job also matches each COD remittance cycle's payout file against delivered orders (markets: IN, reads null for US brands).
encompasses: Match carrier weight/dimension billing against the packed weight recorded at dispatch
File a dispute with the carrier on a documented discrepancy and track it to resolution
Match each COD remittance cycle's payout file against delivered orders and flag a shortfall (India only; markets: IN, reads null for US brands)
Track average settlement lag by carrier against the cash plan (India: COD remittance lag by courier; markets: IN)
Flag a carrier whose disputed-charge rate is rising
founder_sees: The reconciliation shortfall total and any dispute worth the founder's attention.

name: Run a COD-to-prepaid conversion test program
what: Test converting COD-heavy pincodes or repeat-RTO customers to prepaid-only or partial-advance checkout, and read the RTO and conversion-rate change before rolling it wider. India only: reads null and does not run for US brands, where card, PayPal, Apple Pay and BNPL (Affirm, Klarna, Afterpay) already dominate checkout and COD is not a meaningful payment method.
encompasses: Identify pincodes and customer segments with COD share and RTO rate above brand average
Design the test: prepaid-only, partial advance, or a COD convenience fee, on a defined slice of traffic
Set the read point: conversion-rate change against RTO-rate change, not conversion alone
Blacklist or flag a serial-RTO customer for COD ineligibility on future orders
inputs: order data by pincode and customer
founder_sees: The test design and the RTO-versus-conversion trade-off before it goes live.

name: Score couriers and reallocate shipping volume by zone
what: Keep a running scorecard per carrier per zone on failed-delivery/return-to-sender rate, first-attempt delivery rate and delivery transit time, and shift volume to the better performer on a set cadence instead of an annual contract review (India: same scorecard using RTO% by courier and pincode zone; markets: IN).
encompasses: Compute failed-delivery/return-to-sender rate, first-attempt delivery rate and average transit time per carrier per zone from shipment data (India: RTO% per courier per zone; markets: IN)
Rank carriers within each zone and flag one that has fallen below the zone's median for a month
Recommend a volume-share shift between carriers for the next cycle
Track a new carrier's onboarding performance against the incumbent before scaling volume to it
inputs: shipment-level delivery data by carrier and zone
founder_sees: The scorecard and the volume-shift recommendation with the number behind it.

name: Reconcile live inventory across WMS, website and marketplaces to prevent overselling
what: Extend the reorder-point calculation with a real-time on-hand reconciliation across every channel, because a reorder point is only as good as the on-hand number feeding it, and stale stock data on any channel creates a cancellation and a marketplace penalty.
encompasses: Pull on-hand stock from the WMS and every connected sales channel on a short interval
Flag a mismatch between the WMS count and any channel's shown stock beyond a set tolerance
Push a corrected available-to-sell number to every channel from the single reconciled source
Hold a SKU's channel visibility down automatically when true stock hits zero, and restore it on the next confirmed receipt
inputs: channel stock APIs (Shopify, Amazon, Walmart, rapid-delivery marketplaces; india: Flipkart, quick commerce)
founder_sees: Any channel where shown stock and real stock disagree, and the correction pushed.
today_done_by: tool (OMS such as Cin7 or Extensiv; india: Unicommerce or Increff)

name: Assign and validate US sales-tax product categories and catch filing errors
what: Build and keep the SKU-to-tax-category map correct, since a wrong product tax code is a common cause of undercharged or overcharged sales tax and marketplace-facilitator filing mismatches. India: the same job maps each SKU to an HSN/SAC code and catches e-invoice rejections instead (markets: IN, reads null for US brands).
encompasses: Assign an Avalara or TaxJar product tax code to every SKU and check it against each state's taxability rules (India: assign an HSN code and check digit length against the turnover threshold, 4-digit under Rs 5 crore, 6-digit at or above; markets: IN)
Track economic nexus thresholds by state and flag a new state that has crossed the registration threshold
Validate resale certificates on file for wholesale/B2B orders and flag an expired or missing one
Flag a marketplace-facilitator state where the marketplace, not the brand, should be remitting tax, and catch a double-remittance risk
Reconcile 1099-K totals from each marketplace against the brand's own sales ledger
Log every correction with the reason, for an audit trail
inputs: state nexus and taxability rules (india: GST rate table, HSN reference data)
trigger: on new SKU, and monthly audit
founder_sees: Any SKU or state with a wrong or risky tax setup before it causes a filing error.

name: Track FDA, net-quantity and state licence registration and renewal
what: Keep one register of which SKUs need FDA facility registration, net-quantity declaration under the Fair Packaging and Labeling Act, or a state licence (cosmetics, food, supplements), their current validity window, and the relabelling needed on a formula or price change. India: the same register tracks Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) registration and an FSSAI licence instead (markets: IN, reads null for US brands).
encompasses: Map each SKU to the licences it needs: FDA facility registration, state cosmetics/food/supplement licence, and any category-specific licence (India: Legal Metrology state registration and FSSAI; markets: IN)
Track each licence's validity window and flag renewal at a safe lead time before expiry (platforms require 6-12 months left)
Check the label declares net quantity, ingredients and any required warning (Prop 65) correctly, positioned for fulfilment-center or warehouse scanning (India: FSSAI number and MRP; markets: IN)
Track a relabel run when a formula, claim or price changes, keeping required disclosures current (India: keep the original MRP visible on an MRP/GST change, as the rule requires; markets: IN)
inputs: current licence numbers and expiry dates
trigger: monthly audit, and on any formula/price change (india: MRP/GST change)
founder_sees: Any licence expiring soon, and the relabel task list.

name: Track state Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) packaging compliance
what: Register the brand's packaging under state EPR packaging laws (Oregon, California, Colorado, Maine), track the annual filing and recycling-target obligation, and flag when a shortfall means buying EPR credits. India: the same job tracks registration under India's EPR plastic-packaging rules instead (markets: IN, reads null for US brands).
encompasses: Classify packaging by material category under the relevant state's EPR rules (India: by plastic category under India's EPR rules; markets: IN)
Track registration status and each state's annual filing deadline
Compute packaging weight put into the market against the recycling target
Flag a projected shortfall early enough to buy EPR credits or fix the packaging mix
Keep the filing evidence trail for an audit
inputs: state EPR target rules (india: EPR target rules)
founder_sees: The EPR filing status and any credit purchase needed before the deadline.

name: Maintain a single product data layer and syndicate it to every channel
what: Extend the catalogue feed into a full product-data layer, one place for every attribute, that pushes to the website, every marketplace and quick commerce with each channel's own formatting, not just the shopping-ads feed already covered.
encompasses: Hold every attribute (title, description, images, specs, compliance fields) in one record per SKU
Score each SKU's data completeness before it is allowed to push to a new channel
Apply each channel's own formatting rule (image crop, title order, attribute set) at push time
Push an update once and propagate it everywhere the SKU is listed, instead of editing each channel by hand
Catch and surface a channel's rejection reason and hold the retry until it is fixed
Version every catalogue change with who approved it
outputs: per-channel push log and rejection reasons
founder_sees: Any SKU that failed to push to a channel and why.
today_done_by: in-house, one channel at a time by hand

name: Audit catalogue data quality and cross-channel consistency
what: Run a standing audit across every channel's live listings for broken images, missing attributes, duplicate SKUs and the brand's own price mismatch between its site and its marketplace listings.
encompasses: Check every live listing for a broken image link or missing required attribute
Detect a duplicate SKU or ASIN listed twice under different titles
Compare price and stock shown on the brand's own site against each marketplace and flag a mismatch
Score each channel's catalogue completeness and trend it over time
Rank the fixes by traffic or revenue at risk, not just by count
inputs: live listing pull from each channel
brand's own price and stock data
outputs: catalogue quality audit with ranked fixes
founder_sees: The ranked list of catalogue problems by revenue at risk.

name: Format and validate catalogue images and video per channel spec
what: Check every product image and video against each channel's own size, crop and content rule before it is pushed, since an Instacart thumbnail and an Amazon main image have different legibility and content requirements.
encompasses: Check image dimensions, crop and background rule per channel
Check legibility of brand name, MRP and key claim at each channel's thumbnail size
Check FMCG images show the ingredient and nutrition panel where the channel requires it
Flag a video that exceeds a channel's length or format limit
Route a failing asset back with the exact fix needed, not a generic rejection
outputs: fix instruction for a failing asset
trigger: on new asset or new channel
founder_sees: Any asset that will fail a channel's spec, and the fix needed.

name: Track supplier contracts, price locks and renewal dates
what: Keep one register of every supplier agreement's price-lock period, renewal date and key terms, so a price lock does not expire unnoticed and a renewal is negotiated ahead of time, not after the price has already moved.
encompasses: Log agreed price, MOQ, payment terms and price-lock end date per supplier per SKU
Flag a price lock or contract ending inside a set lead window
Compare the current landed cost against the locked price and flag when the lock is now off-market
Hand a renewal that needs real negotiation to the supplier negotiation process, not auto-renew
founder_sees: Any supplier contract or price lock ending soon, and whether it is still on-market.

name: Run three-way PO-invoice-goods-receipt matching
what: Match every supplier invoice against its purchase order and the goods actually received before it is paid, catching a short shipment, an overbilled quantity or a price that drifted from the PO.
encompasses: Match invoice line items against the PO's agreed price and quantity
Match invoice quantity against the goods-receipt record from the warehouse or inspection
Flag a mismatch above a set tolerance instead of auto-approving payment
Route a genuine discrepancy to the supplier with the specific line item in question
Hand the reconciled, approved invoice to Finance for payment
founder_sees: Any invoice that does not match its PO and receipt, and by how much.

name: Monitor supplier and courier spend for billing anomalies
what: Watch every recurring supplier and courier bill against its contracted rate in code, so a quiet rate increase, a duplicate charge or a new surcharge is caught the month it appears, not a quarter later.
encompasses: Recompute each bill's expected amount from the contracted rate and actual volume
Flag a bill that exceeds the expected amount beyond a set tolerance
Detect a duplicate invoice number or duplicate charge across two billing cycles
Track a new line item or surcharge appearing on a bill for the first time
Roll flagged items into a single monthly anomaly report
founder_sees: The billing anomalies found this cycle and the amount at stake.

name: Watch sourcing platforms for new suppliers matching an open spec
what: Keep an open product spec running against Alibaba, 1688 (via a vetted agent), Faire, Tundra and Global Sources in the background, and alert the founder when a new or better-rated supplier appears, without contacting anyone automatically. India: add IndiaMART to the watch list when the brand sources there (markets: IN, reads null for US-only brands).
encompasses: Hold the approved spec (materials, tolerances, MOQ ceiling, target price) as a standing search
Scan new and updated supplier listings on the named platforms on a set cadence
Score a candidate against the spec and the existing vetted supplier's price and rating
Alert only when a candidate beats the incumbent on price, rating or lead time by a meaningful margin
Never contact a supplier without founder approval
outputs: new-supplier alert with comparison to incumbent
founder_sees: Only the alert when a real alternative appears, with the comparison.

name: Score existing suppliers on an ongoing performance scorecard
what: Keep a running scorecard on every active supplier covering on-time delivery, defect rate, responsiveness and price stability, separate from the one-time vetting done before the first order.
encompasses: Compute on-time delivery rate, AQL defect rate and quote-to-response time per supplier from order history
Track price stability: how often and how much a supplier's quote has moved between orders
Rank suppliers within a category and flag one sliding below the category's median
Feed a declining scorecard into the backup-factory and negotiation processes already in place
founder_sees: The scorecard and any supplier that has slid below its category's median.

name: Track factory capacity and production-slot booking
what: Confirm and track a production slot at the exact factory before a PO is placed, since an overbooked factory means a launch date slips without anyone noticing until it is too late.
encompasses: Confirm the factory's open production capacity for the needed window before booking
Log the confirmed slot and the factory's committed ship date
Track WIP status updates against the committed date
Flag a slot at risk of slipping early enough to react
Watch for a factory over-committing capacity across multiple brands' orders
founder_sees: Any production slot at risk of slipping, and by how much.

name: Coordinate packaging durability testing and compliance
what: Book and track the drop-test, tamper-evidence and transit-durability testing a packaging design needs before it goes into production, since a packaging failure in transit is a cost the sample gate does not catch.
encompasses: Identify which tests a packaging design needs (drop test, compression, tamper evidence) for its category and shipping method
Book the test with a lab or the courier's own testing service
Track test results against the pass criteria before releasing packaging for production
Flag a packaging design that needs a redesign before the next test cycle
Keep the test report on file as evidence for a later transit-damage dispute
founder_sees: The test result and whether the packaging is cleared for production.

name: Plan peak-season capacity across warehouse and sourcing
what: Build the Q4 holiday season (Black Friday/Cyber Monday, Prime Day, back to school) readiness plan across safety stock, warehouse staffing and WMS/OMS load, since a peak-season failure shows up as a stockout or a missed SLA at the worst possible time. India: the same plan is built around the festive calendar (Diwali, wedding season) instead (markets: IN).
encompasses: Build the safety-stock uplift by SKU from last year's Q4/BFCM multiplier and this year's growth (India: last year's festive multiplier; markets: IN)
Size the temporary warehouse staffing need against the forecast peak volume
Confirm the WMS/OMS and carrier partners can handle the peak order rate, requesting a load test where offered
Confirm supplier and factory capacity can deliver the peak stock build in time
Set a week-by-week readiness checklist counting down to BFCM and the Q4 holiday window (India: counting down to the festive window; markets: IN)
inputs: last year's peak-season sales data (india: festive sales data)
outputs: peak-season readiness plan and countdown checklist
trigger: annual, ahead of Q4 holiday season (india: ahead of festive season)
founder_sees: The readiness checklist and any capacity gap found before the peak window.

name: Extend Indian marketplace catalogue management to Meesho, JioMart and Snapdeal
what: Apply the same listing creation and upkeep already built for Flipkart, Myntra and Nykaa to Meesho, JioMart and Snapdeal, each with its own title, image and category-attribute rules. India only: reads null and does not run for US brands, which extend to Walmart, Target Plus, eBay and TikTok Shop instead (see PROD-C44's main record).
encompasses: Build and keep current listings on Meesho, JioMart and Snapdeal alongside the existing three
Adapt title, bullet and image rules per platform, the same discipline as the original three
Track each platform's own commission and return-policy differences in the economics model
Flag when a platform's catalogue rule changes and existing listings need a bulk update
founder_sees: The new platform's listing draft and its economics before it goes live.

name: Trace a defect complaint to its production batch and run a supplier CAPA loop
what: When a customer complaint or a return points to a defect, trace it back to the exact production batch or lot using the tech pack's versioning, and run a corrective-action loop with the supplier instead of a one-off refund and move on.
encompasses: Match the defective unit's batch or lot code to the production and inspection record for that run
Check whether other units from the same batch are still in stock or in transit and hold them
Open a corrective-action request to the supplier naming the specific defect and batch
Track the supplier's root-cause response and corrective action to close-out
Log the pattern against the supplier's scorecard if defects recur from the same cause
trigger: on defect complaint above a threshold
founder_sees: The batch trace, what else is at risk, and the supplier's corrective action.

name: Manage cross-factory sample shipment logistics and comparison timeline
what: Track sample shipments arriving from multiple candidate factories through courier and customs so every sample lands and gets tested against the same reference on the same timeline, instead of decisions trickling in as each one happens to arrive.
encompasses: Log the courier tracking number and expected arrival for every factory's sample shipment
Flag a customs hold or delay that will push a factory's sample outside the comparison window
Consolidate arrival status into one comparison timeline so the sample gate runs on all candidates together
Chase a factory whose sample is late against its own committed ship date
founder_sees: The sample arrival timeline and which factory is at risk of missing the comparison window.

name: Run agent-led supplier negotiation within preset guardrails
what: Let an agent run the actual back-and-forth on price and terms with a supplier over email or a messaging channel (WhatsApp where the supplier region uses it) within a founder-set ceiling, floor and MOQ range, and stop and hand back the moment the supplier's counter falls outside the guardrail.
encompasses: Take the founder's price ceiling, target, MOQ range and acceptable payment terms as fixed guardrails
Draft and send the opening ask and each round of counter-response
Pull comparable pricing and the backup-factory benchmark into the negotiation as leverage
Stop and hand back to the founder the moment a counter falls outside the guardrail or a new term appears
Produce a term sheet for founder sign-off once terms land inside the guardrail
Log every message exchanged for the record
trigger: on demand, after leverage is built
founder_sees: The guardrails before it starts, and the term sheet before anything is signed.
today_done_by: nobody (negotiation agents exist for large indirect spend, not yet for small D2C import orders)

name: Decide carrier retry versus return-to-sender acceptance using brand-specific unit economics
what: Go beyond a carrier's generic retry rule and decide, per order, whether another delivery attempt is worth it against this brand's own chargeback/dispute risk, product margin and carrier return fee, accepting the return-to-sender early when the numbers say to stop trying. India: the same decision is NDR reschedule versus RTO acceptance, weighed against COD reversal cost instead (markets: IN, reads null for US brands).
encompasses: Compute the cost of one more delivery attempt (carrier fee, time) against the order's margin and chargeback/dispute risk (India: against COD reversal risk; markets: IN)
Compare that to the cost of accepting return-to-sender now (return freight, restock or write-off cost)
Recommend stop-trying or one-more-attempt per order, not a blanket rule for every exception
Feed the outcome back into the carrier scorecard (India: also into COD-to-prepaid targeting; markets: IN)

external_write.surface: carrier exception panel (india: aggregator NDR panel)

founder_sees: Nothing routine; a summary of how much this saved versus a blanket retry rule.
today_done_by: nobody (aggregators apply one rule to every exception; india: every NDR)
